label: GOES Lightning (GLM) → TAK
info:
Lightning flashes over Tennessee (plus a small buffer) from the GOES-East Geostationary Lightning Mapper, colored by age (yellow under 5 min, orange 5-10, red 10-15) with flash energy and size in the remarks. Markers drop off after 15 minutes.

Data: NOAA GOES-R GLM on AWS Open Data (https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-goes/). Updates every 60 seconds (new satellite files every 20 seconds).

Needs: The jsfive module (see *Satellite and GOES flows* in the main README: same functionExternalModules: true setting).

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Optional: set TAK_CHANNEL in the tab's Environment Variables to send the markers to a TAK channel (for example NWS).
3. Optional: set GOES_BUCKET to noaa-goes18 for GOES-West (default noaa-goes19, GOES-East).
4. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/goes-glm-lightning
